title: winget_install
description: Install a winget package (task queue: Dağıtım, a WINGET step). Sent only to an agent whose connection announced `winget` in `X-Agent-Features`; for any other agent the server marks the task `Denied` (exit code -8) and sends nothing, so an agent that does not implement it never receives it. Same task rules as `execute`: the server marks the task `Running` first, one task per device at a time, the same `task_id` may arrive again and must not run twice at once, `cancel_task` stops it, 30-minute limit. The agent refuses unless the local terminal capability and the lab's `deploy` module are on (`result` with `exit_code` -5 and `capability_denied`), checks `id` and `version` against the patterns below itself, and answers `result` with `exit_code` -7 when winget is not installed. Otherwise it starts winget.exe (the newest Microsoft.DesktopAppInstaller folder under %ProgramFiles%\WindowsApps) as LocalSystem without a shell, each argument a separate ArgumentList entry: install --id <id> -e --silent --scope machine --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements --disable-interactivity, plus --version <version> when set; and answers `result` with winget's exit code. See docs/agent.md#winget_install-contract.

id.description: winget package identifier, matched exactly (-e) and case-sensitively, for example Mozilla.Firefox. The pattern admits no space, quote or shell character; the agent refuses anything else (`result` with `exit_code` -5).

version.description: Version to install; null or missing = the latest. Same refusal rule as `id`.

requested_by.description: Panel user (or API token) who queued it; written to the device's local audit log, as for `execute`.
